scenario: [LGRA.23.2]: a `Time` kwarg takes no `default`, as no kwarg of a builtin type other than `Int`, `Float`, `String` or `Bool` does. `kwarg t: Time default 0` is refused with DS_VALIDATE_SERVICE_KWARG_DEFAULT_TYPE, though `0` is a number a `Time` is stored as. `LGRA.23.2_bytes_default_refused` is the same rule on a `Bytes` kwarg with a String literal. PATH PINNED: `lgra_23_2_default_misfit`'s `te_builtin(_)` arm for a type that is not one of the four, in dsc.validate. Without that arm the program compiles.
rules_ds:
service svc.foo:
    kwarg t: Time default 0
    no response
